subject.title: fix(config): bound external catalog file reads with size limit

question: Should externally configured plugin catalogs above 16 MiB be intentionally skipped with a warning rather than retained as an unbounded compatibility path?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and follows adjacent hardening, but the specific maximum size changes behavior for existing large catalogs and is a product/compatibility threshold rather than a testable correctness fact.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB boundary
options.body: Merge with the warning-based skip behavior, treating oversized external catalogs as unsupported configuration artifacts.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility policy
options.body: Request a documented alternative limit or migration path if existing large catalogs must remain usable.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Merge with the warning-based skip behavior, treating oversized external catalogs as unsupported configuration artifacts.
